newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip starts work on UK Wendy oilfield.
newsitem.headline: Agip starts work on UK Wendy oilfield.

text.p: Agip SpA, part of Italian energy group ENI, said it has started preliminary work to develop the Wendy oilfield in block 210/15a of the British North Sea some 100 km northeast of the Shetland isles.
An Agip statement said the 210/15a discovery well had produced oil during production tests with a capacity of 7,650 barrels per day (bpd).

Two possible alternatives were being studied for the development of the field, involving the use of a vessel equipped for oil production and stockage, or the linking up of the wells to a nearby platform, Agip said.
Production at the field is expected to begin soon.
Agip U.K. has a 19 percent share in the block while Petrofina SA with 54.30 percent is the operator. Other partners are Shell and Exxon Corp with 13.35 percent each.
